content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Conventional platforms like Stripe and PayPal offer a rented storefront. You get a dashboard, payment processing, and basic analytics—but only if you’re in an approved country. For creators in Nigeria, these platforms are either inaccessible or come with crippling restrictions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, operates differently. It’s not a platform; it’s a stack of tools you own. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store for free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. This stack is deployed to your own accounts, giving you full control. There’s no dashboard to log into—just infrastructure you own. The tradeoff? You need to set it up once. The payoff? No platform can shut you down, and no country restrictions apply.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on geopolitical risk, banking regulations, or currency instability. Nigeria is often on this list, leaving creators stranded. Even when access is granted, it’s conditional—accounts can be frozen or restricted without warning. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this entirely. It’s built on open protocols and decentralized tools. GitHub, Cloudflare, and Supabase don’t care about your location. NOWPayments processes crypto payments without KYC, using blockchains like BSC or Solana for fees under $0.10 per transaction. This isn’t a workaround; it’s a structural alternative. You’re not begging for access—you’re building your own system. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this architecture in 48 hours, configured for your products and tested end-to-end. It’s not a temporary fix; it’s permanent infrastructure.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, but that’s irrelevant if you can’t use it. Local payment gateways in Nigeria often charge 5-7% plus additional fees for currency conversionversion. NOWPayments’s 0.5% fee is fixed, with no hidden costs. Payments confirmsations are automatic, firing the moment a transaction is verified on-chain. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep fees under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/ DMARC configuration for email deliver, ensuring your buyers trust your store. Conventional platforms? They charge for the privilege of using them. The real cost? It’s the cost of relying on unstable third parties services. Sovereign commerce infrastructure structure is a one-time investment, with no recurring fees.
Sovereign infrastructure means no platform can shut you down.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Stripe, you rent a platform—but only if you’re in an approved country. You don ’t own the code, data, or infrastructure. If your account is frozen, you lose everything. sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership. Your store is deployed to your own accounts, using tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The Edge Commerce Stack automates this process, loading your products and configuring delivery in 48 hours. There ’s no platform lock-in; it ’s your infrastructure.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Edge Commerce Stack for full automation or Sovereign Starter Stack for basics. 2. Provide product details: name, description, price, and file. 3. Select payment networks: BSC, Solana, or TRON for low fees. 4. Deploy to your accounts: GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting, Supabase or Google Sheets for orders. 5. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase to ensure payment verification and file delivery work. 6. Configure email delivery: set up SPF/ DKIM/ D MAR C for reliable buyer notifications. 7. Launch: share your store link and start selling. 8. Monitor: track orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, and withdrawals from NOWPayments.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed for you, with 30-day support included. You don’t need to write code.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
Your stack uses open protocols. You can switch to another crypto payment processor without changing your infrastructure.
Do I need a website already?
No. The stack includes hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Your store is deployed as a standalone site.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are handled manually by sending crypto back to the buyer’s wallet. The system doesn’t automate this, but it’s straightforward.
Can I scale this to 100+ products?
Yes. The Sovereign Blueprint includes a scaling playbook for expanding your stack as your catalog grows.
